title: Due dates and priority
description: Migration 0002 (due_on, priority, index), Task/TaskInput fields, parseDueOn/parsePriority/PRIORITY_LABELS and parseTaskInput handling them, listTasks ordering (due asc nulls last, priority, newest) plus show/q filters and isOverdue, shared TaskFields component used by both forms, badges/due/overdue in the list, filter bar (Open/Done/All + search), e2e/scheduling.spec.ts, docs how/scheduling.md (diagram: scheduling) and data-model.md updated. Expected shape: wave 1 domain tick (migration, types, validate, repository, tests, data-model.md), wave 2 warm-chain (TaskFields + forms → list rendering + filter bar + e2e + docs). Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-02-organise.md → 'Task fields', 'The list page' (badges, filter bar, ordering), 'Migration 0002', 'Domain', 'App', 'Documentation added', 'Definitions of done → Epic 1'.
acceptance_criteria: A1 pnpm check green; A4 coverage floor; A3 pnpm docs:check --strict after close-out render. Integration tests: migration 0002 on fresh and on 0001-only dbs (ledger 1,2); createTask stores dueOn and priority; open ordering for the spec's five-task input set; show:'done' returns no open rows; q:'milk' matches 'Buy MILK' not 'Bread'; isOverdue yesterday-open true, today false, done-yesterday false. Unit tests: due and priority rules and messages incl. 2026-02-30 rejected. e2e/scheduling.spec.ts: task with Due 2000-01-01 + High shows first with 'High' and 'Overdue'; edit to Low and no due removes both; Done filter shows only the Done section; search 'zzqx' shows 'Open (0)'. how/scheduling.md with the scheduling diagram and data-model.md with the new columns and migration 0002 exist and are listed.
